english.note: Use this when the reservedness comes across as distant or lacking warmth, rather than merely quiet.
Use this when someone is emotionally unresponsive or shows little warmth toward another person.
Use this for a person, manner, or look that feels distant and unfriendly rather than physically cold.
Use this when the emphasis is emotional coldness, indifference, or a lack of responsiveness rather than outright cruelty.
Use this for someone who is unfriendly, distant, or showing little warmth toward others.

examples.english: They are so undemonstrative toward us that I thought we had offended them.
They've been very distant toward me lately.
